---
title: "Prompts"
---

Reusable prompts and skills for automating research in theoretical cryptography, organized by purpose:

- [Research](research/index.qmd) — literature search, conjecture exploration, proof-strategy brainstorming.
- [Proof Checking](proof-checking/index.qmd) — verifying proof steps, finding gaps, formalization assistance.
- [Writing](writing/index.qmd) — turning results into precise write-ups.

Contribute a new prompt by opening a pull request that adds a Markdown file to the relevant subfolder.
